description: Toybox 10K props from ENGINE_REQUESTS #142-#158 (flower_face, hair_bow, torn_sail, sort_chute, cubby_shelf, star_map, mailbox, echo_machine, fountain, chick_face, chick_feet, choir_bench) and #161-#162 (parade_float, wagon, cart, harp, corn_cob, stepping_stone), #172 (trophy_cup, trophy_cabinet, ferry, quiz_buzzer, spotlight), #181 (world_map). Generated by tools/gen_tk_props4.mjs: edit the generator and rerun it, not the JSON.

flower_face.description: A big friendly flower 1.3 m tall in its main colour (petals, default pink): a green stem with two leaves and a ring of eight petals round a flat cream face 0.44 m across. Letter spot: the face's middle at local [0, 1.0, 0.07] (a letter of size 0.25 there, `parent` the flower; or put a `face` sticker on it). Named parts `head` (petals and face: wiggle or turn it to nod) and `leaves`.

hair_bow.description: A hair-ribbon bow 0.4 m wide in its main colour (default pink): two puffy loops, a round knot and two short tails, facing +z. Its origin is under the knot: `parent` it to a character with part "head" and place it on top or at the side of the head (size 0.5 on Pip).

torn_sail.description: A mast 1.8 m tall with a torn sail in its main colour (default white): the sail has a ragged gap near its middle and a loose triangle `flap` hanging from it (wiggle it to flutter; turn it [0, 0, 0] to patch it closed with a move back). Stand it in a `boat` or on a raft; the mast's foot is the origin, the sail faces +z.

sort_chute.description: A sorting machine 1.6 m wide and 1.7 m tall, facing +z: a hopper on legs with a slot on top (mouth at local [0, 1.62, 0]), a slide `chute` under it (hinged at [0, 1.1, 0.1]; turn it [0, 0, 30] to tip toward the left bin, [0, 0, -30] toward the right) and two open bins at its feet: left `bin_left` (blue, middle [-0.55, 0.2, 0.25]) and right `bin_right` (orange, middle [0.55, 0.2, 0.25]). Label spots: each bin's front at z 0.46, y 0.22 (a card of width 0.5). Move a card from the slot down the chute into a bin.

cubby_shelf.description: A classroom cubby shelf 1.85 m wide, 1.75 m tall and 0.45 m deep in its main colour (wood), facing +z, with nine open cubes in three rows. Cube middles (fronts at z 0.22): columns x -0.6, 0, 0.6 and rows y 0.32, 0.87, 1.42; a prop of size 0.4 fits in one, a card label of width 0.45 goes on the cube's lower lip at z 0.24.

star_map.description: A star map 1.6 m wide on a little easel, 2 m tall: a dark board (main colour, midnight blue) with nine gold stars joined by dotted lines into two constellations, a moon in the top-left corner, facing +z. Board middle at local [0, 1.25, 0.06]; a title card goes on the frame's bottom edge at y 0.62. Named part `stars` (all stars: twinkle them with highlight or wiggle).

mailbox.description: A blue street mailbox 1.2 m tall, facing +z: a box with a round top on four short legs, a letter slot with a pull-down `flap` (hinged at its top edge, at [0, 0.98, 0.3]: turn it [-60, 0, 0] to open, then post a card into the slot at [0, 0.93, 0.3]) and a white label panel on the front (label spot at [0, 0.6, 0.31], a card of width 0.45). Set color for another colour.

echo_machine.description: An echo machine 1.3 m tall, facing +z: a box in its main colour (purple) on stubby feet with two dials, a red `button` on top (press: move it down 0.03 and back) and a big gold horn `horn` on the right that points up and out (wiggle it as the echo plays). A round speaker grille faces front at [-0.18, 0.5, 0.3]; a `light` (glow) blinks on top. Pair with `sound` `echo` (repeats a sound softer).

fountain.description: A round garden fountain 1.6 m across: a stone basin (rim top at y 0.45) of blue water with a middle spout and a water `jet` (a glossy water column from y 0.45 up to 1.25). The jet is built to grow from its foot: scale `<id>#jet` to [1, 0.1, 1] to start it low and back to [1, 1, 1] to make it spring up. To lift something on the water, put it at [0, 1.3, 0] (parent the fountain) and move it up with the jet; at scale 0.1 it rests at y 0.53.

chick_face.description: A chick's face to stick on a letter (letter-shaped chicks): two shiny black eyes and an orange beak, plus a little feather tuft on top, 0.3 m wide at size 1, facing +z with its origin at the beak. `parent` it to a letter piece (`word#c1`) near the top of the letter's front face (z just past the letter's depth, about 0.2 x size).

chick_feet.description: A chick's two orange feet (three toes each), 0.3 m wide at size 1, origin between them on the ground: `parent` it to a letter word at the foot of a letter so the letter stands on chick feet.

choir_bench.description: A two-step choir riser bench 1.6 m wide in its main colour (set color: one per vowel), facing +z: a low step (seat top y 0.3, middle z 0.25) in front of a high step (seat top y 0.6, middle z -0.2). Critters stand on it at those heights; a letter or a card label goes on the low step's front at [0, 0.15, 0.46].

parade_float.description: A low parade float 1.6 m long (along x) and 0.9 m deep, facing +z: a flat deck in its main colour (top at y 0.32) with a scalloped white skirt down to four hidden wheels, a gold rail along the back and a sign board on two poles above the back edge (board middle at local [0, 1.2, -0.38], a card or letter of width up to 1.3 goes on its front at z -0.34). Riders stand on the deck at y 0.32 (z -0.1 to 0.3): nothing hides them. Move it along x for a parade.

wagon.description: A little pull wagon 1 m long (along x) in its main colour (red): a low open tray (floor at y 0.26, rim only 0.08 high, so riders and labels show), four black wheels and a handle at the front (+x end) that tilts up. A rider stands on the floor at y 0.26; a label goes on the side at [0, 0.27, 0.31] (a card of width 0.6). Pull it with move (`by` works well).

cart.description: A wooden farm cart 1.5 m long (along x): an open box bed (floor at y 0.55, sides 0.25 high) on two spoked wheels (0.8 m across) with two long handles reaching out to +x. A load (pumpkins, hay, letters) sits on the floor; a label goes on the side board at [0, 0.68, 0.36]. Main colour: the bed.

harp.description: A golden harp 1.3 m tall, facing +z (its strings in the x-y plane): a curved neck on top, a straight pillar at the front (-x) and a sloping sound box at the back (+x), with nine white strings that are `strings` (wiggle or highlight them to play; pair with a soft chime sound).

corn_cob.description: A corn cob 0.45 m long standing up: a glossy yellow cob of kernel bumps with three green husk leaves peeled down round its foot and a little stalk. Lay it down with rotation [0, 0, 90] (it then lies along x, middle about 0.12 m up).

stepping_stone.description: A flat round stepping stone 0.6 m across, top at y 0.1, in its main colour (grey) with a mossy green rim. Lay several in a line across water or grass; a letter, number or tile stands on top at y 0.1 (a hop target for a critter).

trophy_cup.description: A gold trophy cup 0.45 m tall on a dark wooden base, with two loop handles, facing +z. A label goes on the base front at [0, 0.04, 0.09] (a card of width 0.2) or a letter or number of size 0.12 on the cup at [0, 0.3, 0.14].

trophy_cabinet.description: A glass-fronted trophy cabinet 1.4 m wide and 1.8 m tall, facing +z: a wooden frame in its main colour with three shelves (tops at y 0.42, 0.92, 1.42), a gold trophy cup on each, and a see-through glass `door` hinged at its left edge (turn it [0, -100, 0] to open). Put a `trophy_cup` (size 0.8) on a shelf at z 0, x -0.4 to 0.4 to add one; the middle of the top shelf is free.

ferry.description: A friendly little car ferry 3 m long (along x, bow at +x), floating with its waterline at y 0.25: a white hull with a red stripe and a row of round windows, a flat open deck (top at y 0.6) where a car or characters ride, a small blue cabin with a funnel at the back (-x) and a fold-down `ramp` at the bow (hinged at [1.45, 0.6, 0]; turn it [0, 0, -60] to lower). Move it along x to cross the water; label spot on the cabin front at [-0.55, 1.05, 0.46].

quiz_buzzer.description: A big round quiz buzzer on a little desk post, 1 m tall, facing +z: a black base and a domed `button` in its main colour (red) on top (press: move `<id>#button` by [0, -0.04, 0] and back, with a buzz or ding sound) and a `light` ring that glows (pop or paint it when a team buzzes in). A team label goes on the post front at [0, 0.55, 0.13] (a card of width 0.35).

spotlight.description: A stage spotlight 1.7 m tall on a tripod: a dark lamp can (main colour) tilted down toward +z with a glowing lens, and a soft see-through `beam` of light (cream) reaching 3 m ahead and down to the floor about 2.6 m in front. Turn the whole spotlight about y to aim it; hide / show `<id>#beam` to switch it off and on (paint the beam for a coloured light). For a pool of light on the floor add a glowing `disc` shape there.

world_map.description: A world map on the wall, 2.4 m wide and 1.4 m tall (its middle 1.25 m up), facing +z: a sky-blue sea (main colour) in a wooden frame with simple green and sandy continents where they really are. Put a pin, flag, label or critter on a country with `on: { map: "<id>", country: "japan" }` (or `lat` and `lon`): it rides on the map at that spot (at adds an offset). Countries: usa, canada, mexico, brazil, argentina, peru, chile, colombia, uk, ireland, france, spain, italy, germany, greece, norway, iceland, russia, egypt, nigeria, kenya, ethiopia, south_africa, morocco, saudi_arabia, india, china, japan, korea, indonesia, philippines, thailand, australia, new_zealand, greenland, antarctica. Stand it on legs: none; hang it on a wall or put it on an easel at y 0.
